response.answer: Corinna Ullrich is a leading researcher in organic farming innovation, known for her work at Organic Field Days in Germany, and her expertise is highly regarded in this field. She has published significant research on evaluating organic farming strategies and innovations. Her work focuses on sustainable agricultural practices.

results.content: # Evaluation of innovations and strategies for organic farming – results from a survey at the Organic Field Days in Germany. Assessment of the importance of innovations/innovative processes for the development of organic arable farming; participants with occupation or interest in arable farming, number of responses: N = 172. Assessment of the importance of innovations/innovative processes for the development of organic dairy farming; participants with occupation or interest in dairy; number of responses: N = 79. A different survey location may reveal even greater differences in the evaluation of innovations and strategies between organic and CFs. Owing to the low number of participants in some stakeholder groups, especially in the evaluation of innovations for organic dairy farming, this study should be considered exploratory; further research could be carried out to verify the results.
